conventions.off: (fwd, side) in R from the CoM: fwd along the frame, side to its right as seen (board y down)
conventions.frame: 'vel' = heading (core.js slowHeading, Upward on), 'axis' = B->G body axis
conventions.turn: degrees, + clockwise as seen (right), measured once the name box names it again (at least 30 steps after the hold), against an untouched copy from the same start
conventions.spot: centre, or a direction (front, front-right, ... in the frame) on the body (0.45 R) or at its edge (0.9 R)
conventions.phase: steps since the main peak of the total mass in its cycle (0 .. period - 1), when the action starts
conventions.p: share of the start phases and angles with this outcome

limus.chaotic: amoeba-like: red dots round its blue body push or pull it, themselves appearing, vanishing and moving at random; maneuvers not well defined
